notes.title: New Version of the demo!
notes.notes: New version of the demo is now out! There is now controller support! I will continue refining the controls but you can now fully play the demo with a controller. I also made the decision to change the audio control to be interactable via the keyboard and controller instead of having to use the mouse. I also have a schedule set to work on the game more often, I look forward to updating you on my development.
